raw_evidence:
A single maker pass claims and closes exactly one work item. The atomicity rule is:

1. **One lease per turn.** The agent claims at most one work item per execution turn.
   A turn ends when the agent pushes a pull request or marks the item `failed`.
normalized_decision: An agent claims at most one work item per execution turn; the turn ends when the agent pushes a pull request or marks the item `failed`.
candidate_rule: Agent claims at most one work item per turn; turn ends on PR push or item failure
human_notes: Approved candidate boundary. Source: ADR-007 lines 15-18. One-work-item-per-turn claim atomicity only. Does not absorb allowed_edit_set, checker independence, or protected-path rules.
